ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a joining word
   B. Only an action
   C. Only a describing word
   D. A person, place, thing, or idea

2. When practising Connected text reading and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text reading and fluency.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Connected text reading and fluency.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Connected text reading and fluency.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text reading and fluency.

3. When practising Pre- Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre- Writing.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Pre- Writing.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Pre- Writing.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Pre- Writing.

4. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. One main idea with supporting sentences
   B. Many unrelated topics with no link
   C. Only one word repeated
   D. No full stops

5. When practising Attentive listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive listening.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Attentive listening.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Attentive listening.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive listening.

6. When practising Pronunciation and Vocabulary, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Pronunciation and Vocabulary.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pronunciation and Vocabulary.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Pronunciation and Vocabulary.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Pronunciation and Vocabulary.

7. When practising Letter sound knowledge, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Letter sound knowledge.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Letter sound knowledge.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Letter sound knowledge.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Letter sound knowledge.

8. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. quickly
   B. blue
   C. run
   D. happiness

9. When practising Word reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Word reading.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Word reading.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word reading.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Word reading.

10. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. goed
   B. goes
   C. going
   D. went

11. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.

12. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library
   B. where is the library
   C. Where is the library?
   D. Where is the Library

13. When practising Language structures School, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Language structures School.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Language structures School.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Language structures School.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language structures School.

14. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.

15. When practising Pre-reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Pre-reading.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre-reading.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Pre-reading.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Pre-reading.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Word reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Connected text reading and fluency and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Pre- Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Handwriting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Spelling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Punctuation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
